correctness.rationale: Generator identities for moments M_ij=E[x^i v^j], S_ij=E[x^i v^j sigma] are triangular by polynomial degree. They yield M20=(g+2u)/(gB), M02=2u/(gB), mixed M22=2uQ/(g^2(3g^2+4)BCE); subtracting M20*M02 gives the exact negative factor -4uP/[g(3g^2+4)B^2CE] before physical energy scaling. Independent SymPy exact cancellation verified the polynomial factorization; a separate rational moment linear solve at (g,u)=(1/5,1/3) agreed with source mixed moment. Denominators are positive, every positive-power u coefficient of P is positive, and P(g,0)=(6g^2-1)(3g^2+9) with partial_g P>0, proving a unique decreasing zero for 0<g<1/sqrt6, none above; g->0 root 1/(2sqrt3). This is an unrestricted sign proof, not an extrapolation from finite checks.
